name: Damora Therapeutics, Inc. Ordinary Shares
description: Damora Therapeutics Inc is a biotechnology company that aims to fundamentally redefine care for people with hematologic disorders. The group is advancing a new generation of biologics to treat mutant calreticulin-driven myeloproliferative neoplasms, including essential thrombocythemia and myelofibrosis, where there is cruicial medical need for disease-modifying treatments. Its goal is to rapidly bring forward optimized therapies with broad mutation coverage and exceptional convenience to dramatically improve patient outcomes. The group's pipeline products are DMR-001, DMR-002, DMR-003, and GB3226.
